Acids (like lemon juice) and bases (like wood ash or baking soda) react chemically to neutralize each other, producing salt, water, and fizzing carbon dioxide gas.

3. Observe the rapid bubbling eruption of carbon dioxide gas!

Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide from the air to produce glucose energy and release fresh oxygen.
